basic.name: System Warning
basic.description_template: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Allow Changes?
skill.description_template:
There is a {{weakness_chance}}% base chance to add 1 Weakness of an on-field ally target's Type to one designated enemy target (prioritizing the implant of a Weakness that matches the first character in the team lineup). This also reduces the enemy target's RES to that Weakness Type by 20% for 3 turn(s). If the enemy target already has that Type of Weakness, the RES reduction effect to that Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy target can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be retained.
In addition, there is a 100% base chance to further reduce the target's All-Type RES by {{all_res_down}}% for 2 turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Silver Wolf's ATK to this target.

ultimate.name: User Banned
ultimate.description_template: Has a {{base_chance}}% base chance to reduce the DEF of all enemies by {{def_down}}% for 3 turns. At the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies.

talent.name: Awaiting System Response...
talent.description_template:
Silver Wolf can create three types of "Bugs": Reduce ATK by {{atk_down}}%, reduce DEF by {{def_down}}%, and reduce SPD by {{spd_down}}%.
After every attack launched by Silver Wolf, she has a {{bug_chance}}% base chance to implant 1 random "Bug" that lasts for 3 turn(s).
When the enemy gets defeated, the Weakness Silver Wolf implanted on it will be transferred to another surviving enemy on the field that hasn't been implanted with Weakness by Silver Wolf, prioritizing Elite-level and above.

technique.name: Force Quit Program
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG equal to 80% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies and reduces Toughness of all enemies regardless of Weakness Types. Enemies with their Weakness Broken in this way will trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.

2.name: Generate
2.description: The duration of "Bug" is extended by 1 turn(s). Every time an enemy's Weakness gets broken, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance of implanting a random "Bug" on that target.

4.name: Inject
4.description: When the battle starts, immediately regenerates 20 Energy. When Silver Wolf's turn starts, she regenerates 5 Energy.

6.name: Side Note
6.description: For every 10% Effect Hit Rate Silver Wolf has, additionally increases her ATK by 10%, up to a max of 50%.

eidolons.name: Social Engineering
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate to attack an enemy target, Silver Wolf regenerates 7 Energy for every debuff on the target. This effect can trigger up to 5 time(s) in each use of Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Zombie Network
eidolons.description: When an enemy target enters combat, increases their DMG taken by 20%. When an enemy target gets attacked by ally targets, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance to implant 1 random "Bug" on the attacked enemy target.

eidolons.name: Payload
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Bounce Attack
eidolons.description: After using Ultimate to attack an enemy target, deals Quantum Additional DMG equal to 20% of Silver Wolf's ATK for every debuff on the target. This can trigger up to 5 time(s) per target during each use of Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Brute Force Attack
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Overlay Network
eidolons.description: For every debuff the enemy target has, the DMG dealt by Silver Wolf to it increases by 20%, up to a max increase of 100%.
